executor_separation: Fresh executor first accessed the private package only after published preregistration and explicit execution go; root and tuning roles receive aggregate data only.
limits: This is procedural separation within one team, not an independent organization or controls-engineer review.
Local retained hashes are comparison anchors, not external attestation or protection against whole-history replacement.
The API alias is mutable. No immutable model-weight or deployment identity is established.

Full HTTP response envelopes are represented by retained digests and selected metadata, not retained bytes; those full-envelope digests cannot be independently recomputed. Exact completion content and request digests were audited.
A single small synthetic holdout does not establish plant safety or authorize operational promotion.
methods: Rehashed every retained private artifact and frozen package file without executing the materializer.
Verified every evidence chain link and head, and compared the SQLite rows to exported bundles using read-only database access.
Bound each retained input, frozen expectation, unmodified final candidate and scored result to one ordered evidence run and terminal outcome.
Recomputed primary result and evidence fidelity independently; recomputed aggregate reports from retained rows.
Reconstructed every candidate and warmup request from the fixed prompt, entry, response, tool and protocol events and verified canonical and wire SHA-256 digests.
Compared exact retained raw completion content parsed as JSON to response events without repair and reconciled warmup plus scored calls to contiguous call numbers.
